tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Search the paid x402 APIs listed on x402Fi (Robinhood Chain, priced per call in USDG). Every word of the query must match. Returns endpoints with their price, method and payee name; use get_listing for how to call one.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: One listing's details: every live endpoint with its URL, method, price and how to call it (query params, path params, JSON body, example output), plus the payee name, settled-call count and the payout wallet's Priors credit record.

tools.name: get_payment_requirements
tools.description: The exact x402 402 (price, USDG asset, payTo, network, extensions) for one specific request to an x402Fi endpoint, without paying or calling the paid endpoint. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_listing · Private data: get_listing, get_payment_requirements · Public sink: get_payment_requirements.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_listing · Private data: get_listing, get_payment_requirements · Public sink: get_payment_requirements

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
